findings.title: Discount math wrong: returns price * percent
findings.explanation: Discount formula is inverted. Old code computed amount * (1 - pct/100). New code returns amount * rate, so percent=10 turns $100 into $1000 instead of $90. Percent=100 returns full price squared scale, percent=0 returns 0.

evidence.why: Returns amount * rate instead of amount * (1 - rate/100); e.g. 10% off 100 returns 1000.

findings.suggestion: Restore: pct = Decimal(str(percent)); return quantize(amount * (1 - pct / 100))

findings.title: Float money math breaks Decimal contract and cents rounding
findings.explanation: Replaces to_money/Decimal/quantize with float. Breaks documented Decimal return rounded to cents and introduces binary floating-point errors for money. Callers expecting Decimal will break.

evidence.why: Converts money to float and returns float, dropping to_money, Decimal, and quantize to cents.

findings.suggestion: Use amount = to_money(price); pct = Decimal(str(percent)); return quantize(amount * (1 - pct/100))

findings.title: Removed 0-100 percent validation allows invalid discounts
findings.explanation: Removed pct <0 or pct >100 ValueError guard. Now percent=-50 or 200 is accepted, yielding negative totals or large overcharges with no error.

evidence.why: No 0-100 range check remains; negative or >100 percents produce negative or inflated prices.

findings.suggestion: Re-add: if pct < 0 or pct > 100: raise ValueError(f"percent out of range 0-100: {percent!r}")
